column1: # op-class v1 line map (reviews/opclass_procedure.md, section 4; step 2.1). Written and committed before any count.
# Source: lampcore/src at the commit that adds this file. Format: file <TAB> first line <TAB> last line <TAB> class <TAB> note.
# The ranges tile every line of every file in lampcore/src exactly once (opclass/check_map.py checks this).
#   a type of evolve/optypes.TYPE_ORDER - the line's work is paid by a charge of that type;
#   meter              - the meter and its read-only instrumentation (charges, ticks, tests, event counters, the per-type
#                        split, the --phasetime / LPBREAK / SIEVEBREAK snaps, charge amounts computed only to be charged);
#   uncharged:card     - card work the meter's cost model does not charge (prime generation, parameter computation,
#                        constant tables, per-attempt allocations, the polynomial's c, genome reading);
#   uncharged:harness  - the driver: input parsing, the stage loop, output;
#   @caller            - a helper shared by callers of different classes: its cost belongs to the calling line;
#   decl               - declarations and comments (no instructions expected; any Ir landing here is reported, not dropped).
#   R1 Meter override: a line whose text, stripped, starts with "m.charge(", "m.tick(", "m.test(", "m.ev(", "crate::pt_",
#      "crate::sv_units(", or "let pt", "let ps", "let ptl", "let pt_a", "let pt_pre" followed by " = crate::pt_snap", is
#      class meter whatever its range says.
#   R2 Inlined code: an instruction is credited to the innermost frame of its DWARF inline chain whose file is in
#      lampcore/src. If that line's class is @caller, move outward to the next lampcore/src frame, and so on.
#   R3 Code with no resolvable lampcore/src line (library code not inlined - malloc, memcpy, __divti3, __udivti3,
#      libm log, ruint or std functions kept out of line - or a non-inlined @caller function): its cost goes to the
#      lampcore line that called it, through callgrind's call edges: an edge's share of the callee's unresolved cost is
#      its share of the callee's inclusive Ir. Recursively, until a resolved line is reached.
#   R4 Cost that reaches no lampcore line (process start-up, the C main shim, exit) is "unattributed" and reported.
#   R5 Lump mode: in a run whose genome is a single cfrac, sq or ps stage (inputs.json "lump"), every class other
#      than meter, uncharged:harness and decl counts as that run's lump class (cfrac_ops, sq_ops or ps_ops): the
#      meter types every op of those lamps as the lump, including the shared ledger and ks_rank code.
#   R6 Weight per class = the Ir attributed to the class over all runs / the class's op count over all runs, the
#      counts summed from lampcore --types on the same inputs (the T columns).
# JUDGEMENT CALLS (stated so they can be reviewed)
#   - Loop control, index arithmetic, loads, stores and buffer pushes that exist only to carry out a charged piece of
#     work go with that work's type (e.g. the sieve walk's loop with sieve_update, the root storage with setup_small).
#   - Lines mixing two types take the dominant one: ecm.rs 48, 55, 57, 232 (a multiply with an add/sub inside) are
#     mul; pm1 stage 2's acc line (673) is mul; qs confirm's "v /= p" lines are confirm_td, its "ev[j] += 1 / tt.push"
#     lines are word (the "sets" charged as word).
#   - The kept relation's storage in the ledger (Ledger::add, qs.rs 387-390) is word (the charged sparse copy). The
#     partial's storage in the partial table (qs.rs 1272-1274) is hash (the charged insert).
#   - ks_rank / ks_eval / ks_prep are mapped for their qs meaning (mult, word, f64_log). In sq's "ks" mode they would
#     be sq_ops (R5 covers this: the sq supplementary run is in lump mode).
#   - The A-primes' extra exponent adds (qs.rs 1236-1243) are word (item 15 charges them as word).
#   - race.rs: not exercised by the input set; mapped uncharged:card except the hook (meter).
